sloka: यत्तु शक्यं बलवता कर्तुं प्राकृतबुद्धिना।अनुपासितवृद्धेन कः कुर्यात्तादृशं बुधः ।। ६.६४.५ ।।
transliteration: yattu śakyaṁ balavatā kartuṁ prākṛtabuddhinā।anupāsitavṛddhena kaḥ kuryāttādṛśaṁ budhaḥ ।। 6.64.5 ।।

translations.english: " A strong person of unsophisticated intellect, who is progressive, a knower of everything will do such a task which is not possible to do?"
